{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|You may specialize in sniping, shields and marksmanship, or stealth, technology and close-quarters engagement. The quartermaster will get you started.|Commander Vasil Dorne|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''sniper combat specialization program''' was one of a number of combat specialization programs utilized by agents of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. Agents who underwent the program specialized in the use of [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]], shields, and marksmanship skills. [[Cipher Nine]] qualified for the [[Operative combat specialization program|operative]] and sniper programs.
